نتبادل (form VI)
# نَتَبَادَلُ (natabādalu) /na.ta.baː.da.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَبَادَلَ (tabādala)
# نُتَبَادَلُ (nutabādalu) /nu.ta.baː.da.lu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of تَبَادَلَ (tabādala)
# نَتَبَادَلَ (natabādala) /na.ta.baː.da.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَبَادَلَ (tabādala)
# نُتَبَادَلَ (nutabādala) /nu
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
